title: Affiliate Partnership Manager
location: Chennai, India; Pune, India; Bangalore, India; India
jobDescription:
About Fireflies.ai: Fireflies.ai is the #1 AI teammate for meetings, trusted by over 20 million people across more than 500,000 organizations from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Whether in sales, project management, marketing, operations, or product development, Fireflies is revolutionizing team collaboration by capturing knowledge, automating repetitive tasks, and enhancing productivity before, during, and after every meeting. Recognized as a category-defining platform, Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. Ramp data shows Fireflies is the 6th most purchased AI platform in the US. Chances are, you’ve already seen Fireflies in action, quietly powering one of your recent meetings. About the

ROLE:
As an Affiliate Partnerships Manager, you will own and scale Fireflies.ai ’s affiliate ecosystem, driving affiliate-sourced customer acquisition, revenue growth, and strategic partner engagement. You will be responsible for building a world-class affiliate program by recruiting, activating, and growing relationships with affiliates, publishers, influencers, review sites, agencies, and strategic partners. This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled affiliate programs at a high-growth Saa S company and is excited about building a category-defining growth channel at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world. You’ll work closely with Growth, Marketing, and Revenue teams to expand Fireflies’ reach and drive measurable business impact through affiliate channels and partnerships. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and Maintain Affiliate Partnerships: Establish and nurture relationships with affiliates, publishers, influencers, review sites, agencies, and strategic partners to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth. Strategic Growth: Identify opportunities to scale Fireflies' affiliate channel through partner recruitment, activation programs, commission optimization, growth initiatives, and more. Affiliate Recruitment & Expansion: Source, onboard, and activate high-performing affiliates that align with Fireflies’ target audience and growth objectives. Co-Marketing & Visibility: Lead affiliate marketing campaigns, promotions, content collaborations, and product launch initiatives to increase Fireflies’ reach and brand visibility. Partner Engagement: Collaborate with affiliate partners to create content, improve conversion rates, drive adoption, and maximize partner performance. Measurement & Reporting: Track and report affiliate performance, revenue contribution, conversion rates, partner engagement, and key growth KPIs. Management of Fireflies.ai 's existing and new affiliate programs. Design commission structures, payout terms, and performance tiers that are attractive to partners and sustainable for the business. Create the assets partners need to succeed — links, creatives, messaging, landing pages — in collaboration with Marketing.

QUALIFICATIONS:
3–7+ years in affiliate marketing, partnership management, growth marketing, or business development. Proven track record of scaling affiliate programs and driving meaningful revenue growth. Experience recruiting, managing, and growing relationships with affiliates, publishers, influencers, agencies, and strategic partners. Strong understanding of performance marketing, attribution, conversion funnels, and customer acquisition. Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills. Data-driven and results-oriented with a strong focus on ROI and growth metrics. Experience working with remote, distributed teams. (Good to have) Experience managing affiliate programs on affiliate platforms such as First Promoter, Partner Stack, CJ Affiliate, AWIN, etc. Values that are Important to Us: You should be a great communicator and culture maintainer. You're data-driven and customer-focused. You value fast and incremental execution. You maintain operational excellence while minimizing complexity. You measure your results and automate whenever possible. You strive to get 10% better every week. You have an internal compass and take accountability and initiative. We value overcommunication, candid feedback, and a results-driven culture. Perks and Benefits: Competitive compensation Work remotely anywhere in your respective country Ability to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly Paid time off and flexible leave policy No boss culture Flexible working hours LGBTQ+ friendly Company offsites Tech reimbursements About Us: At Fireflies.ai, we’re revolutionizing the way teams interact with AI in their daily work. Our inclusive culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from top-tier investors like Canaan, Khosla Ventures, and angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a passionate 100+ member global team spanning 20+ countries and every timezone. We’re building a world-class, global-first team, and we dogfood our product to do so. We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly value diversity at our company because our team will be stronger with different perspectives and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Brand & Web Designer
jobDescription:
Fireflies.ai is the #1 AI teammate for meetings, trusted by over 20 million people across more than 500,000 organizations from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Whether in sales, project management, marketing, operations, or product development, Fireflies is revolutionizing team collaboration by capturing knowledge, automating repetitive tasks, and enhancing productivity before, during, and after every meeting. Recognized as a category-defining platform, Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. Ramp data shows Fireflies is the 6th most purchased AI platform in the US. Chances are, you’ve already seen Fireflies in action, quietly powering one of your recent meetings. We’re looking for a Brand & Web Designer to shape how Fireflies shows up across product and marketing. You have strong visual taste, care deeply about how things look and feel, understand what makes someone stop, read, and engage, and can turn ideas into clear, high-quality visuals. You’ll be directly responsible for how Fireflies is marketed and understood. This means taking our features and capabilities and turning them into ads, storyboards, and videos that people can instantly grasp. You’ll work closely with the team to shape how we present new launches, simplify complex ideas, and make sure everything we put out feels clear, engaging, and on brand. What You'll Work On: Digital Ads: Design performance-focused assets for paid channels like Meta, Google, and Linked In. These need to stop the scroll and communicate value instantly. Storyboards: Create visual assets and scenes for launch and explainer videos. This includes product visuals, UI moments, and simple narrative flows. Emails: Design newsletter banners, feature announcements, and promotional visuals that feel clear and lightweight, not crowded. Landing Pages: Design new pages with strong hero visuals, section graphics, and product-focused illustrations that reinforce the message. Social Media Assets: Design product-first posts that highlight features, use cases, and outcomes in a simple, engaging way. Marketing Materials: Create assets such as event slides, in-app banners, posters, and website visuals that feel consistent with our brand. Brand Ownership: Evolve and maintain the Fireflies visual system. This includes setting standards and making sure they are consistently applied across marketing and product surfaces. What We Care About: Marketing Mindset: The goal is to create visuals that don’t just look good but also drive clicks, engagement, and conversions. Your designs will be seen by millions. Ownership and Taste: You have a strong point of view and can make decisions without waiting for direction. You care about raising the overall quality bar. Fundamental UI Skills: Since many assets involve product UI, a solid grasp of UI principles like visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and alignment is essential. Motion with Intent: Animation should help communicate ideas, highlight important moments, and guide attention. Figma Enthusiast: We rely heavily on Figma for creating and collaborating on design assets across teams. You must be a Figma pro and come with a good understanding of Auto-Layout and other relevant features to maintain consistency and efficiency. Efficiency & Organization: Well-structured design files, clear layer naming, and optimized workflows will help the entire team collaborate smoothly.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Proven experience in visual design and branding. Proficiency in design software (e.g., Adobe Suite, Figma, After Effects). Strong portfolio demonstrating skills in branding, motion design, and graphic design. Experience working on web and landing page designs. Good understanding of user experience (UX) design principles. Ability to work collaboratively and manage projects independently. Values that are important to us: You should be a great communicator and culture maintainer Take a look at our culture document You're data-driven and customer-focused You value fast & incremental engineering cycles You maintain design excellence and minimize complexity You measure your results & automate when possible You get 10% better at something every week You have an internal compass and take accountability & initiative We value overcommunication, candid feedback and a results-driven culture Perks and benefits: Competitive compensation Work remotely anywhere in your respective country Ability to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly Paid time off and flexible leave policy No boss culture Flexible working hours LGBTQ+ friendly Company offsites Tech reimbursements About us: At Fireflies.ai, we’re revolutionizing the way teams interact with AI in their daily work. Our inclusive culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from top-tier investors like Canaan, Khosla Ventures, and angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a passionate 100+ member global team spanning 20+ countries and every timezone. We’re building a world-class, global-first team, and we dogfood our product to do so. We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly value diversity at our company because our team will be stronger with different perspectives and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Customer Success Manager
jobDescription:
Fireflies.ai is the #1 AI voice assistant -- automating note-taking, making meetings searchable, and turning voice into action & insights. It integrates into Zoom, Google Meet, and all major web-conferencing platforms. Fireflies is trusted by over 20M users across 300k+ companies worldwide. Ramp recognized Fireflies as the 6th most popular AI platform behind Open AI, Midjourney and Anthropic. Chances are you’ve seen Fireflies in one of your meetings! We are seeking a passionate and results-driven Customer Success Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while using our Saa S products. You will be responsible for building strong, lasting relationships with our customers, understanding their needs, and guiding them to success. Customer education and Adoption of features like Implementing AI apps, integrations, workflows, Health checks, low usage analysis, and ensuring retention.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Customer Onboarding: Assist new customers in getting started with our product, providing guidance, and training, and ensuring a smooth onboarding process. Account Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customer accounts. Act as their main point of contact and advocate within the company. Exploring expansion opportunities and PLS Product Expertise: Become an expert in our Saa S product(s) and stay updated on new features and enhancements. Be able to effectively communicate product benefits and solutions to customers. Customer Training: Create and deliver training materials and webinars to help customers maximize the value of our product. Customer Support: Address customer inquiries, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary. Ensure timely responses to customer support tickets. Customer Feedback: Gather customer feedback, case studies, quotes, g2 reviews, and insights to provide input to the product development team for continuous improvement. Renewals and Upselling: Monitor customer usage and work on renewing subscriptions. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services or features. Customer Success Plans: Collaborate with customers to create and execute customer success plans that align with their goals and objectives. Churn Prevention: Proactively identify and address factors that may lead to customer churn. Develop strategies to mitigate churn and increase customer retention. Reporting: Maintain and provide regular reports on customer engagement, satisfaction, and product usage to internal stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Business, Marketing, Computer Science, etc.). Previous experience in a Customer Success role, preferably within the B2B Saa S industry. Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills. Excellent problem-solving abilities and a customer-centric mindset. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team. Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software is a plus. Note: Availability to work in the PST time zone and accommodate North American customer needs. Values that are important to us: You're data-driven and customer-focused You have excellent communication written and oral (a must-have for remote teams) You measure your results & automate when possible You get 10% better at something every week You have an internal compass and take accountability & initiative You thrive in globally distributed, 100% remote teams Perks & Benefits: Competitive compensation Work remotely from anywhere Opportunities to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly Paid time off and flexible leave policy A "no boss" culture that empowers you to take ownership Flexible working hours to fit your lifestyle LGBTQ+ friendly Fun international offsite to connect and recharge Tech reimbursements to support your work About us: At Fireflies.ai, we’re dedicated to revolutionizing the way teams interact with AI in their daily workflows. Our inclusive culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from top-tier investors like Canaan, Khosla Ventures, and angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a passionate 100+ member global team spanning 20+ countries and every timezone. We’re building a world-class, global-first team, and we dogfood our own product to do so. We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly value diversity at our company because our team will be stronger with different perspectives and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
